system.description:
The Servant covers himself in a humming field of ebon eldritch power. This spell combines the effects of Eldritch Shield and Turn Aside the Blade. Divide successes between physical and spell protection.

Obstacle: 4^. Actions: 10.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Caster | Element: Arcana, Earth | Impetus: Tax, Control | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 16

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 247
